# Results

The coverage of the percentile bootstrap interval was `r num("covS3n100")` at $n = 100$ in scenario S3
(Monte Carlo SE `r num("covS3n100mcse")`; $n_{\mathrm{sim}} = `r num("nSim")`$).

```{r tab-summary}
#| label: tbl-summary
#| tbl-cap: "Performance measures by scenario and sample size (Monte Carlo SE in parentheses)."
d <- res("{study}_summary.csv")
d$cell <- sprintf("%.3f (%.4f)", d$estimate, d$mcse)
kable(reshape(d[, c("scenario", "n", "measure", "cell")], idvar = c("scenario", "n"), timevar = "measure", direction = "wide"),
      row.names = FALSE)
```
